reuseDecision: Extend the canonical table model and CCD: profiles live per table, never global mutable physics. Retain the American baseline and legacy wire defaults. Reuse the existing native dialog and licensed Phosphor SVG subset; cache graphics instead of adding a second engine.
nonGoals: Full pyramid rules or tournament-accurate certification
Server deployment or new online features
Changing other games or overwriting concurrent island work
